name: University of Manchester
description: The University of Manchester is a public research university and Russell Group member, formed in 2004 by the merger of the Victoria University of Manchester and UMIST. It has one of the largest student populations in the United Kingdom.
whyIncluded: The University of Manchester is among the 10 universities in the United Kingdom most chosen by international students (18,515 non-UK students in 2024-25, per HESA), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: BSc Computer Science
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2027. Manchester may raise it by up to 7% a year for later years of the degree. No separate compulsory fees.
programmes.notes: International fee read on the 2027-entry course page ('Tuition fees for international students will be GBP 39,700 per annum'), 2026-10-07; 3-year programme. The 2026-entry course page gives 37,800 for the 2026/27 academic year. Manchester states that for subsequent academic years it reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year, so cohortLocked is false. Manchester says fees cover registration, tuition, examinations and graduation, with no separate compulsory fees.

programmes.name: MBChB Medicine
programmes.summary: First-year tuition for international students (2026-27 rate). Fees rise to a higher clinical rate from Year 3 and may increase by up to 7% a year. No separate compulsory fees.
programmes.notes: The 2027-entry course page quotes the 2026/27 rates: pre-clinical (Years 1-2) GBP 39,900 per year for students starting in September 2026; clinical (Years 3-5) GBP 60,900 for students entering the clinical part in 2026, set at the rate applicable when entering Year 3. First-year (pre-clinical) fee used per the calculator's medicine rule. 5-year programme, open to overseas applicants. Read 2026-10-07. The 2025-entry URL redirects to the 2027 page, so no earlier figure. Manchester states that for subsequent academic years it reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year, so cohortLocked is false. Manchester says fees cover registration, tuition, examinations and graduation, with no separate compulsory fees.
